title: Boswellia serrata tea for medicinal use
intro: Boswellia serrata tea is a herbal preparation made from the resin of the boswellia tree, commonly known as frankincense. It has been used for centuries in traditional medicine, particularly in Ayurvedic and Middle Eastern practices. The tea is valued for its potential anti-inflammatory and pain-relieving properties. It is often consumed to support joint health and reduce symptoms of conditions like arthritis. In herbalism, it is used to promote overall wellness and aid in the management of inflammatory disorders.
